Subject: Hiring Update - Finalized Offer Details

Hi Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I would like to share the finalized offer details for our recent candidate in the hiring process.

- **Position:** [Position Title]
- **Salary:** [Salary Amount]
- **Start Date:** [Start Date]
- **Benefits:** [Brief Overview of Benefits]
- **Additional Notes:** [Any Other Relevant Information]

Please review this information at your earliest convenience, and let me know if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]  

[END]

I can send this for you — before I do, I need a few details to complete and send the message:

1. Fill in the placeholders:
   - Position title:
   - Salary amount:
   - Start date:
   - Benefits (brief overview):
   - Additional notes (if any):
   - Your name, your position, contact info (how you want the signature to appear)

2. Recipients:
   - To (one or more email addresses):
   - CC (if any):
   - BCC (if any)

3. Send timing:
   - Send now, or schedule (if schedule, give ISO timestamp or date/time and timezone)?

If you’d like, I can also:
- Polished the wording and format of the message.
- Add attachments (offer letter, benefits summary) if you tell me which existing email attachments to include.
- Save a copy in a specific folder or label.

Optional: below is a polished version you can use as-is once you fill the placeholders — tell me when to send.

Subject: Hiring Update — Finalized Offer for [Position Title]

Hi Team,

I hope you’re well. I’m sharing the finalized offer details for our candidate:

- Position: [Position Title]  
- Salary: [Salary Amount]  
- Start Date: [Start Date]  
- Benefits: [Brief overview of benefits]  
- Additional Notes: [Any other relevant information]

Please review and let me know if you have any questions or need clarification.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]

Tell me the missing details and the recipients and I’ll send it right away.
